answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The thread lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the whisper is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
